title: Invoke a lambda fallback supplied by a Feign fallback factory
summary: The real HTTP 400 response invoked an application-package lambda. Two failing GETs received fresh fallback-1 and fallback-2 values, while a successful GET bypassed the factory.

change.description: A factory-created fallback now receives the same reflective method preparation as a directly configured fallback. This matters when the application creates its lambda in a different package from the handler.

notes: The factory contract creates a fallback per exception. A single constant fallback result cannot detect reuse across calls.
